_note: pip install playwright (uses system Chrome by default).
_keys_note: PassthroughKeySpec: curriculum 'keys' map a physical key (the JSON key -- a scanner button, say) to the key the GAME listens for (the value, e.g. 'SPACE'); the action is the held set of game keys, '+'-joined. Collect cheese to open the mouse hole, then escape before the cats catch you. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand -- the canvas paints the game's own key names, so name the button standing in for each.
